description: Returns static copy-paste code templates for workout embeds (keyHandshake iframe), program page embeds, custom player JavaScript, or Content API cURL snippets. All samples contain only placeholder values (YOUR_ORG_ID, YOUR_API_KEY) — no real credentials are fetched or transmitted. Defaults sample_type to embed_prebuilt when omitted. Use when the user asks for embed code, iframe HTML, or API snippet examples. Not for integration strategy or step-by-step plans (use get_integration_plan).

browse_tool.description: Widget hint: the list the card's "Browse" button reopens, e.g. "list_team_workouts". Does not change the data.

program_id.description: Program ID for embed_program_page or content_api_plan_workouts, from list_team_programs. Omit to keep the {programId} placeholder.

sample_type.description: Snippet to return. embed_prebuilt = saved-workout iframe; embed_ai_generated = iframe for AI-generated workout JSON; embed_program_page = program page iframe; custom_progress / custom_navigation / custom_integration_flow = JavaScript for your own player; content_api_list_plans / content_api_list_workouts / content_api_list_groups / content_api_plan_workouts = Content API cURL calls. Defaults to "embed_prebuilt".

workout_id.description: Workout ID to put in the snippet, from list_team_workouts or list_sample_workouts. Omit to keep the {workoutId} placeholder.

name: get_embed_code_samples
title: Get embed code samples
